bio.text: Shawn Johnson is the Libertarian candidate for Wyoming's U.S. House seat in 2026.
In his WyoFile election guide response, Johnson says he was born in Casper and now lives in Thermopolis.
He says he served 21 years in the Army National Guard as a combat medic, including a deployment to Iraq in 2003-2004, and 13 years as a jail deputy with the Natrona County Sheriff's Office.
He says he served on the Casper City Council from 2014 to 2022, earned a law degree from Mitchell Hamline School of Law, and is now an attorney.
